newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Salomon says no longer coordinator for Datang IPO.
newsitem.headline: Salomon says no longer coordinator for Datang IPO.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said on Thursday it was no longer the global coordinator for the planned share flotation of China's Beijing Datang Power Generation Co.

"We received a notice on December 13 saying that we are no longer in the management of the global listing," a Salomon spokeswoman in Hong Kong said, adding that the notice took effect on the same day.
She said she believed Salomon had been dropped by Datang due to disagreements over the pricing of the share offering.

"Salomon did elaborate pre-marketing but did not go to the road show stage," she said. "The resultant price at which the deal would have been supported by institutions was not a price acceptable to the company."
The spokeswoman declined to comment on the price.
Datang plans to raise US$300 million through a dual share listing in Hong Kong and London.
Salomon Brothers said in November that Datang had delayed its listing plans due to a weak H-share market. H-shares are shares of China-incorporated enterprises listed in Hong Kong.
